We recently migrated our paid membership community to Circle.so and faced serious bugs that aren't resolved to this date. Some of them are critical enough to warrant immediate fixing because we are losing paid members, but Circle just decides to burry this somewhere deep in their backlog and act like nothing important is happening.  
  
Additionally, when such bugs are reported, customer support goes AWOL for a few days, instead of responding with urgency and at least recognizing what is happening.
